"}, {"insert": {"image": "https://storage.googleapis.com/indie-hackers.appspot.com/post-images/5jpsSF0k2OZKIntPYgTT/vOqaQ3DJwYRP8MNEjUOSMger71w1/f45047de-7951-4a8f-9fcf-1aed09312234.png"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "> 作者: (HabitKit创始人)", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "> 标签: 受众构建、自举创业、公开构建、移动应用", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你有没有在就业和创业之间来回摇摆？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他有。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2019年发现Indie Hackers社区。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " finishing university，被IH podcast上分享business details的cool people super inspired。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "做了三年软件工程师，但想要creative freedom："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "负责自己的产品、spontaneously选择daily tasks、建lifestyle可以work on what he loves。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2022年辞职 pursue indie hacker梦想。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一年后，limited traction，回老工作，把app development变成side hustle。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但apps开始generate enough revenue support lifestyle，2024年2月又辞职。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "目前在三个移动应用上工作，App Store和Google Play都有："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "HabitKit", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "：旗舰app和主要收入来源。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Minimalist habit tracking app，用GitHub-like grid显示consistency。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2024年11月hit 15000美元月收。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "不再分享specific numbers，但continued to grow since then。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Liftbear", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "：第一个app，born from passion for weightlifting。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "找不到满足所有需求的tracking app。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "WinDiary", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "：第三个app，帮remember past victories和personal achievements，尤其在difficult times。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "第一个产品Liftbear，开发了六个月，从没gain any traction。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Reflect on what went wrong后，决定 pursue completely new idea——HabitKit，minimalist habit tracking app。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这次不同approach。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "设了tight deadline only 2 months release第一版，force自己keep scope small、focused on core functionality。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "整个开发过程，在Twitter上build HabitKit in public，分享journey和progress的一切。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Post screenshots from early development stages，ask for feedback from audience，quickly add their suggestions。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "主要用Flutter，因为可以用one codebase build for iOS和Android。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Fast to develop，really like design flexibility。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Backend其实不多：HabitKit fully local和privacy-focused，没external server。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "用SQLite做local data storage。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Subscriptions用RevenueCat，analytics用Appfigures。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "ASO通常用Astro。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "最近在开发新app——Pomodoro focus timer。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这个会built for iOS用native technologies——SwiftUI、SwiftData、iCloud Sync等。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "商业模式简单：所有app用freemium model。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Download和use for free，但有Pro version unlock extra features。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "HabitKit提供monthly和yearly subscriptions，还有lifetime one-time purchase。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这组合work really well，因为some users prefer pay once and be done with it，others fine with small monthly fee。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "January总是最好月份，因为everyone wants build new habits。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "大部分revenue在这时make。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "大部分用户directly来自App Store和Google Play。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "花了很多时间学习App Store Optimization (ASO)："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Good screenshots", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Great title + subtitle", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Right keywords", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Clear description", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "除此之外，Twitter是main channel。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Talk about indie hacking journey，post updates、screenshots、new features等。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "People like see behind the scenes，sometimes posts get shared bring a lot of new downloads。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Beginning时super important，still helps a lot——visibility和motivation都有。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "最大挑战之一是staying patient和motivated。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Mobile apps通常don't take off right away，很长时间feel like building into the void。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "有几个月nothing really moved，keep going很难when you don't see results——尤其savings draining away的时候。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "所以，don't give up too early。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "First few months通常slow，can feel like nobody cares。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但如果keep improving、listening to users、sharing progress online，things can change really fast。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "话虽如此，not every app will be success，totally fine。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Just have to keep learning and move on to next one。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在主要goal是keep improving HabitKit，make even more useful for people who want build better habits。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Still many ideas want to add!"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "同时也在working on new app，iOS的Pomodoro focus timer。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Small、fun project，want combine clean design with simple productivity tools。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Already have some early builds running，really excited about how it's turning out。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "长期，只想keep growing small app business，stay independent，build products people actually enjoy using every day。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "

content_en:
Building Mobile App Portfolio, $15K+/Month


> Author: (Founder of HabitKit)

> Tags: Audience Building, Bootstrapped, Build in Public, Mobile Apps


Have you ever swung between employment and entrepreneurship?

He did.

Discovered Indie Hackers community in 2019.

Finishing university, super inspired by cool people on IH podcast sharing business details.

---

Worked as software engineer for three years, but wanted creative freedom:

Own products, spontaneously choose daily tasks, build lifestyle to work on what he loves.

Quit job in 2022 to pursue indie hacker dream.

---

One year later, limited traction, went back to old job, turned app development into side hustle.

But apps started generating enough revenue to support lifestyle, quit again in February 2024.

---

Currently working on three mobile apps, on App Store and Google Play.

Combined revenue over $15K/month.

---

Key insight: Keep your day job while validating, then jump when the time is right.
content_jp:
モバイルアプリポートフォリオを構築、月1.5万ドル以上


> 著者：（HabitKit創業者）

> タグ：オーディエンス構築、ブートストラップ、パブリック構築、モバイルアプリ


就職と起業の間で揺れたことある？

彼はある。

2019年にIndie Hackersコミュニティを発見。

大学卒業間近%、IHポッドキャストでビジネス詳細を共有するcoolな人にsuper inspiredされた。

---

3年間ソフトウェアエンジニアとして働いた%、但しクリエイティブフリーダムを求めた：

自分のプロダクトを持つ%、毎日タスクを自発的に選擇し%、ライフスタイルを構築して好きなことができる。

2022年に退職%、indie hackerの夢を追う。

---

1年後%、traction限定的%、元の仕事に戻った%、アプリ開発をサイドハスルに。

でもアプリがライフスタイルを支えるだけの収益を生み出すようになった%、2024年2月にまた辞职。

---

今、3つのモバイルアプリに取り組んでる%、App StoreとGoogle Playで。

合わせて月1.5万ドル以上の収益。

---

重要な洞察：検証中は仕事を続け%、タイミングが来たらジャンプしろ。
content_ar:
بناء محفظة تطبيقات متنقلة، أكثر من 15 ألف دولار شهرياً


> المؤلف: (مؤسس HabitKit)

> الكلمات المفتاحية: بناء الجمهور، البدء بدون استثمار، البناء علناً، التطبيقات المتنقلة


هل سبق وأن تذبذبت بين التوظيف وريادة الأعمال؟

فعل.

اكتشف مجتمع Indie Hackers في 2019.

أنهى الجامعة، ألهم بشكل كبير الأشخاص الرائعين في بودكاست IH الذين يشاركون تفاصيل العمل.

---

عمل كمهندس برمجيات لمدة ثلاث سنوات، لكنه أراد الحرية الإبداعية:

امتلاك المنتجات، اختيار المهام اليومية تلقائياً، بناء نمط حياة للعمل على ما يحب.

استقال في 2022 لمتابعة حلم القرصنة المستقلة.

---

بعد عام، محدودية النمو، عاد إلى عمله القديم، جعل تطوير التطبيق مشروعاً جانبياً.

لكنبدأت التطبيقات توليد ما يكفي من الإيرادات لدعم نمط الحياة، استقال مرة أخرى في فبراير 2024.

---

يعمل حالياً على ثلاثة تطبيقات متنقلة، على App Store و Google Play.

الإيرادات المجتمعة أكثر من 15 ألف دولار شهرياً.

---

رؤية رئيسية: احتفظ بوظيفتك أثناء التحقق، ثم اقفز عندما يحين الوقت المناسب.
